# Digest AI

> The AI news desk: every important story in artificial intelligence, digested and linked to its sources, updated every 20 minutes. Each story page carries a plain-English digest, three key points, why it matters, the list of outlets that reported it with links and dates, and the full text of the lead article, credited. Nothing is published without a named source.

Site: https://digestai.news
Contact: hello@digestai.news
Corrections policy: https://digestai.news/about#corrections
Editorial standards: https://digestai.news/about#standards

## What is where

- Today's briefing (the five stories that matter, updated every 20 minutes): https://digestai.news/today
- Front page: https://digestai.news/
- AI at Work (practical AI for marketers and small businesses: what a tool does, who it is for, cost, effort, one caveat): https://digestai.news/work
- Tool directory (AI tools for marketing and small business, newest change first): https://digestai.news/work/tools
- Model tracker (releases with lab, type, availability, licence, context window): https://digestai.news/models
- Funding tracker (rounds, acquisitions and valuations as reported, one row per deal): https://digestai.news/funding
- Developing stories (threads that update as coverage grows): https://digestai.news/threads
- Categories: https://digestai.news/category/models, /category/marketing, /category/agents, /category/research, /category/business, /category/policy, /category/hardware, /category/enterprise, /category/robotics, /category/society
- Weekly recaps: https://digestai.news/week
- Audio briefing and podcast: https://digestai.news/listen
- About, privacy, terms, contact: https://digestai.news/about, /privacy, /terms, /contact

## Every story as data (best for quoting and citing)

Add .json or .md to any story address. Both carry the canonical URL, headline, digest, key points, why it matters, category, names, first-published and updated dates, every source (outlet, title, URL, date, primary-source flag), where the reports agree and differ, and a ready-made citation. They contain Digest AI's own text and links only, not publishers' articles.

- Story as Markdown: https://digestai.news/story/<slug>.md
- Story as JSON: https://digestai.news/story/<slug>.json
- Latest 100 stories (JSON index, links to each story's JSON): https://digestai.news/api/latest.json
- Today's briefing (JSON): https://digestai.news/api/briefing.json
- Newest 50 per category (JSON): https://digestai.news/api/category/<slug>.json (slugs: models, marketing, agents, research, business, policy, hardware, enterprise, robotics, society)
- Documentation, fields and examples: https://digestai.news/api

Static files rebuilt every 20 minutes, no key, CORS open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *).

- Podcast (daily briefing): https://digestai.news/podcast.xml
- Podcast (AI at Work, weekly): https://digestai.news/work/podcast.xml

## How to cite

Cite the story page (https://digestai.news/story/<slug>) and the original outlets it links to; each story lists them with publication dates. Suggested form: Digest AI, "<headline>", <date first published>, https://digestai.news/story/<slug> (each story's .json has it ready in cite.text). Digests are written by Digest AI from those sources and marked as such; quoted figures and names are checked against the sources before publishing, and stories are corrected or withdrawn when a source retracts. Reuse terms: https://digestai.news/terms#reuse
